values./items/9/system/description: The Miss Nanny is a robot. They are immune to the effects of starvation, thirst, and suffocation. They are also immune to Poison and Radiation damage. However, machines cannot use food and drink or other consumables, they do not heal naturally, and the Medicine skill cannot be used to heal them: damage to them must be repaired (p.34).
values./items/10/system/description: The Miss Nanny is immune to the effects of all diseases, and they will never suffer the symptoms of any disease.
values./items/11/system/description: The Miss Nanny has 360° vision, and improved sensory systems that can detect smells, chemicals, and radiation, reducing the difficulty of PER tests that rely on sight and smell by 1. It moves through jet propulsion, hovering above the ground, unaffected by difficult terrain or obstacles.
values./items/12/$overrides/~1system~1descripti: Scavengers can salvage from a destroyed Miss Nanny with a successful INT + Science test with a difficulty of 1. This yields 2d20 flamer fuel, 2 CD units of common materials with +1 CD per AP spent, and each Effect rolled yields 1 uncommon material.
values./items/13/system/description: The Miss Nanny reduces all Poison damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from poison.
values./items/14/system/description: The Miss Nanny reduces all Radiation damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from radiation.
